category_one_hint: Categories are only saved and shown to clients when there are at least two.
service_remove_body: People will no longer be able to book it. Bookings already made are kept.
no_services: Add at least one service to be able to publish.
time_zone_hint: Times are shown in this time zone. It was set when you added the question.
approval_timeout: If I do not answer in
window_days: How far ahead people can book (days)
error_price_currency: Add a currency for the price
fix_errors: Some fields need fixing. Check the messages in red.
gen_overlap: Each session lasts longer than the step, so some times overlap.
gen_err_invalid_step: Use 30, 60, 90, 120 or a value between 5 and 600.
gen_err_invalid_duration: The service duration is not valid.
gen_err_invalid_range: The end must be after the start.
gen_err_no_times: These rules leave no time. Change the step or the break.
gen_err_unknown: Could not generate the times. Try again.
exc_hint: Close a day or a whole period, or give a day its own times. People cannot book a closed day.
exc_sum_none: No days off or special hours
min_notice_hint: From 0 minutes to 30 days. 0 lets people book right up to the start.
exc_to_hint: For a period, such as a holiday.
exc_services_hint: Save a new service first to pick it here.
err_exc_range: The end cannot be before the start
wd_hint: A day with its own times ignores the times above. Leave a day without any time to close it.
bundle_hint: For example, take 5 sessions and pay for 4. Needs a price.
bundle_example: Example: {{take}} sessions cost the price of {{pay}}.
error_bundle: Taken must be 2 to 31 and paid at least 1 and fewer than taken
error_timeout: The deadline must be from 5 minutes to 30 days
error_waitlist_timeout: The deadline must be from 15 minutes to 3 days
categories_hint: The customer picks a category first, then a service.
category_remove_body: No service is deleted. Its services move to another category.
category_name_error: Give the category a name (up to 60 characters)
approval_soon_only: Only ask for approval close to the time
approval_soon_hint: Bookings made further ahead are confirmed straight away.
approval_within: Ask for approval when booked less than
reminders_hint: Up to three. Each one is sent once, before the visit. None selected means no reminders.
verify_email: Ask the client to confirm their email
verify_email_hint: The place is held for 15 minutes. Without a click it is released and you hear nothing about it.
monthly_hint: The client picks a month, weekdays and a time, and every matching day is booked at once. Days off are skipped; if any other day is taken, nothing is booked.
monthly_price: Monthly price (shown only, nothing is charged)
monthly_price_hint: Shown next to the option. Kurz does not take payments.
monthly_price_needs_price: Add a price above to show a monthly price.
waitlist_hint: Clients can queue for a full time. When a place opens it is held for the first in line. Needs a form whose only required questions are name, email and the booking.
